messages:
jon_sales: Heads-up — handing off Protea Health (enterprise trial) to CS. Key asks: SAML SSO, private VPC peering, initial dedicated capacity (2x A100) for benchmarking, IP allowlist, and quota: ~200M tokens/month expected. Procurement timeline ~45d, flagged renewal sensitivity if perf/cost targets aren’t met. Deal notes: https://redwood.example.com/deals/PROTEA-1123 :eyes:

maria_cs: Thanks @jon_sales — assigning myself. Quick Q: are they requesting Private deployment or Dedicated on hosted? Do we have SAML metadata or an IdP contact yet?

jon_sales: They requested Private (VPC + optional on-prem gateway) and want SSO. No SAML metadata yet — procurement asked for a sample SAML request we previously sent (see deal attachments). I also shared the AM contact (elena@proteahealth). I quoted 2xA100 for p95 latency target during benchmark.

maria_cs: Okay. @devon_eng can you confirm infra feasibility for 2xA100 in their region and estimate lead time for Dedicated allocation + VPC peering? Also need a minimal network template we can share with them.

devon_eng: Can do. Two quick asks: 1) We need customer ASN + target CIDR for peering and public egress expectations. 2) If they want cross-replica KV caching, we must pin model version and quantization profile (affects memory/latency). Which model are they planning to serve?

jon_sales: They're starting with redwood/fast-7b. Willing to test 4-bit quantized variant for cost savings. I'll add model choice and contact info to deal notes now.

sam_support_bot: New ticket created: CS-4821 — Protea Health provisioning. Ticket link: https://tickets.internal/CS-4821.

maria_cs: Action items (captured in CS-4821):
- Devon to post infra checklist (ASN, CIDR, firewall rules, peering window) and sample network template.
- Devon to validate A100 capacity scheduling and ETA.
- CS to schedule onboarding call (I can lead) week of 2027-04-12.
- Support to prepare migration/playback runbook + escalation contacts.
- Sales to confirm procurement dates and share SSO contact and procurement SLAs.

devon_eng: I'll post the checklist and the sample SAML metadata XML + network template in CS-4821 by EOD today. Preliminary ETA: ~10 business days for dedicated allocation after approvals; VPC peering depends on customer network change window.

lara_support: Quick note — if they need burst capacity during testing we can failover to hosted endpoints as a temporary fallback, but org approval required for cross-tenant routing. Also capture renewal risk: they noted pricing pressure; recommend enabling Redwood Optimize monitoring during trial so we can report cost-per-inference and suggested batching/quantization changes.

maria_cs: Good call @lara_support. I'll enable Optimize monitoring and add a baseline prompt eval set so we can detect quality regressions vs. quantized model. Also preparing a short SAML exchange runbook — who can provide the metadata sample?

devon_eng: I'll attach a sanitized example SAML metadata XML and a sample network ACL template to CS-4821. Also will include recommended model pin (fast-7b-q4) and expected memory footprint.

jon_sales: Thanks everyone. Final ask: please list single owners + SLAs in the ticket so I can update the customer-facing onboarding timeline.

maria_cs: Owners added in CS-4821: maria_cs (CS lead), devon_eng (infra/alloc), lara_support (support/escalations), jon_sales (account AM). I also scheduled kickoff.

sam_support_bot: Reminder: Kickoff meeting scheduled for 2027-04-15 16:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to participants.

jon_sales: :thumbsup: Thanks team — I'll ping if procurement shifts the timeline.
